Name: Feishin
Description: Control Feishin, a modern self-hosted music player

de.felitendo.feishin.playpause.Name: Play/Pause
de.felitendo.feishin.playpause.Tooltip: Play or pause the current track

de.felitendo.feishin.repeat.Name: Repeat
de.felitendo.feishin.repeat.Tooltip: Switch between repeat off, repeat all and repeat one

de.felitendo.feishin.volumeup.Name: Volume Up
de.felitendo.feishin.volumeup.Tooltip: Turn the volume up (hold to keep going)

de.felitendo.feishin.volumedown.Name: Volume Down
de.felitendo.feishin.volumedown.Tooltip: Turn the volume down (hold to keep going)

de.felitendo.feishin.forward.Name: Fast Forward
de.felitendo.feishin.forward.Tooltip: Jump forward in the current track (hold to keep going)

de.felitendo.feishin.rewind.Name: Rewind
de.felitendo.feishin.rewind.Tooltip: Jump back in the current track (hold to keep going)

de.felitendo.feishin.volumedial.Name: Volume Dial (Stream Deck +)
de.felitendo.feishin.volumedial.Tooltip: Rotate to change the volume, press to mute

de.felitendo.feishin.seekdial.Name: Seek Dial (Stream Deck +)
de.felitendo.feishin.seekdial.Tooltip: Shows the current track; rotate to seek, press to play or pause
